Priya (eng-security): Quick sync: pen-test readiness signalboard — retest window Wed 10:00-16:00 UTC. Need confirmation on three things before Monday EOD: 1) RBAC temporary roles for assessors, including exact perms and rotation window; 2) KMS decrypt access pattern for evidence bucket + any CMK policy changes; 3) audit/log export path and retention (we prefer 90d for now). Also: deployment freeze window and how we surface canary rollbacks. TL;DR: want a clean, auditable handover with minimal blast radius.
Ethan (eng-sre): We can do an ephemeral role `assessor-readonly` via STS AssumeRole with max session 8h. Need assessor AWS account IDs + list of S3 prefixes they should access. Will scope to: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket for evidence prefix only. No write perms. Also recommend presigned URLs for any large evidence pulls to avoid bucket-wide perms.
Priya (eng-security): @Ethan sending the assessor IDs in DM. Assessor will need KMS decrypt for the evidence objects they access. Can we gate KMS by a condition on aws:PrincipalArn or the STS session tag? Prefer session tag `assessor=true` so CMK policy can require it.
Ethan (eng-sre): Yep — CMK policy can include Condition: {StringEquals: {"aws:RequestTag/assessor": "true"}} and we enforce tagging at AssumeRole. Example IAM snippet I can apply:

```
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "aws:RequestTag/assessor": "true"
  }
}
```

Will also create a short-lived role in our account that the assessor assumes via their account ID. I’ll post the role ARN once ready.
Maya (eng-ops): For audit logs: we plan to export CloudTrail + ALB/app logs to sec-evidence-prod S3 with prefix `pt-<engagement-id>/raw/` and ship to our SIEM. Retention: set S3 lifecycle to 90d and push a copy to glacier for 1y for forensic. Question: do we need app-structured logs (json) redaction before export? That affects timeline.
Priya (eng-security): Good call. We want structured app logs too but redact PII server-side. Ops team: can you run a small redaction dry-run and share a sample within the evidence bucket (presigned link)? Don't include real creds — synthetic only.
Oliver (eng-platform): Deployment freeze: recommend freeze from Wed 08:00-18:00 UTC (2h buffer on each side). Also will enable canary monitoring on inference endpoints and set an auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% or latency spike > 200ms for 5m. I'll add routing fallback policy to serve a smaller model variant if primary capacity degrades during the run.
Priya (eng-security): Perfect. That rollback threshold looks fine. We must document the freeze in the release calendar and tag the release instruments.
sec-bot: New pen-test intake created: SEC-2026-78. Evidence bucket: `redwood-pt-2026-78` (read-only presigned access for assessors). Dry-run export: Tue 18:00 UTC. Oncall: @Ethan. Retest window: Wed 10:00-16:00 UTC. Ticket permalink: https://redwood.internal/security/tickets/SEC-2026-78
Ethan (eng-sre): Quick note on presigned URLs: I'll upload a single manifest file under `pt-2026-78/manifest.json` with presigned links for large artifacts and put a short-lived index for assessors. Command I ran in dry-run: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-2026-78/trace-20260321.tar.gz --expires-in 43200` (12h). If we need longer windows we should wrap with our presign proxy.
Maya (eng-ops): Dry-run for redaction/export scheduled Tue 18:00 UTC — I'll share a presigned sample after the run in this thread. Also will add S3 lifecycle rule and CloudTrail filter to include only `pt-2026-78/*`.
Priya (eng-security): Owners: Ethan = ephemeral role + presigned manifest; Maya = redaction dry-run + lifecycle + siem hookup; Oliver = freeze + canary + rollback. I'll be the assessor liaison and own the evidence handoff doc. Can we have a short readiness check Tue 19:30 UTC in #eng-security? :white_check_mark:
Ethan (eng-sre): Ack — role + role-ARN posted Tue EOD. Will tag sessions with `assessor=true` and enforce sts:TagSession in trust policy.
Maya (eng-ops): Ack — will post sample and lifecycle rule after dry-run. If redaction tooling needs tweaks we may ask for extra 2hrs Tue night.
Oliver (eng-platform): Ack — I'll set freeze + canary now and post runbook link. Also will annotate the rollback threshold in the ticket.
Priya (eng-security): Awesome. Final checklist for Monday EOD before intake handed to assessors: - role ARN and trust policy posted - presigned manifest created - redaction sample in bucket - lifecycle + cloudtrail export confirmed - freeze/calendar entry visible - evidence readme with access instructions
Priya (eng-security): If anything slips, flag in this thread. Otherwise we’ll do the 19:30 check-in. Thanks team :pray:
